clue.text: Keep it secret? Not at all!

definitions.meaning: a plea to tell nobody about something
a polite reply brushing aside thanks or an apology

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether to keep a matter quiet and gets an emphatic refusal.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both a request for silence about a matter and a courteous dismissal of thanks, like 'think nothing of it'.

clue.text: Alternative to a conservative speechifying

parts.note: or introduces an alternative
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: An option to a Conservative politician holding forth at length.
explanation.definitionFit: Oratory is the art of public speaking, which speechifying is in a pompous form.

clue.text: Nurse in attendance

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the word attendance, so in signals a run hidden there

explanation.surface: A nurse is present on the ward.
explanation.definitionFit: To nurse someone is to look after or care for them.

clue.text: Give claim to name

definitions.meaning: to grant someone a right to something
to give a title to, as a book is called something

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to give a right to something and to call a book or work by a title.

clue.text: Showing off a chest without a lid

explanation.surface: A treasure chest is displayed with its cover removed.
explanation.definitionFit: Bare-breasted describes someone with the upper body uncovered, and literally it also means having no top or cover.

clue.text: Like a rugby ball used by cricketers

definitions.meaning: egg-shaped, as a rugby ball is
a London cricket ground where Test matches are played

explanation.surface: A rugby ball being borrowed by a cricket team.
explanation.walkthrough: THE OVAL is a famous Test cricket ground in Kennington, south London.
explanation.definitionFit: A rugby ball is egg-shaped, and the Kennington Test ground carries that same shape name.

clue.text: I translate bear in Spanish and Portuguese

indicators.note: to translate is to turn words into another form, so these letters are rendered in a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An instruction to render the word bear into the languages of Spain and Portugal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'translate' rearranges I, BEAR and IN into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The peninsula shared by Spain and Portugal is named for the Iberi people, so its inhabitants share that adjective.

clue.text: A flying leap?

parts.note: a leap taken literally from an aircraft, drifting down under a canopy

explanation.definitionFit: A skydiver's descent from a plane under a canopy is literally a leap made in flight.

clue.text: When most people stop work

parts.note: a day off shared by the whole nation, such as a bank holiday

explanation.definitionFit: A national day off such as a bank holiday is when the general workforce downs tools.

clue.text: Anti-cooking, anti-gas

indicators.note: cooking the books means fiddling them, so these letters are doctored into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone opposed to cookery and to gas.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean opposed to, as in voting one way or the other on a motion.

clue.text: High-rise flat

parts.note: reads as an apartment in a tower block but means level ground at altitude

explanation.definitionFit: A tableland is an elevated area of level ground, literally flat land that rises high.

clue.text: He shows Sam there's nothing to be upset about

indicators.note: upset means knocked over and jumbled, so these letters are put in disorder

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A man reassures Sam that there is no reason to be distressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be upset' rearranges SAM and O. 'He' is the definition: a male figure, here the Old Testament prophet.
explanation.definitionFit: The Old Testament prophet with his own book is one particular man.

clue.text: A way always short and direct

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way

indicators.note: short means a letter is missing, the contraction dropping the middle letter

parts.note: e'er is the poetic contraction meaning always

explanation.surface: A route that is forever brief and straight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' cuts the V from EVER to give the poetic E'ER.
explanation.definitionFit: To guide a vehicle or a person along a course is to steer them.

clue.text: Nursery slope climber

parts.note: a figure in the nursery rhyme who goes up the hill with Jack to fetch water

explanation.definitionFit: In the nursery rhyme, Jack's companion climbs a hill to fetch a pail of water.

clue.text: Cultivate sex appeal and a figure

parts.note: to cultivate soil is to dig it
it is old slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: Developing allure and a shapely body.
explanation.walkthrough: IT for sex appeal comes from the 1927 film 'It' starring Clara Bow.
explanation.definitionFit: A single numeral from 0 to 9 is a figure in arithmetic.

clue.text: Sellers soak the buyer with such prices

definitions.text: Sellers soak the buyer with such prices

parts.words: Sellers soak the buyer with such prices
parts.note: soak means both to overcharge and to drench, and the price word also means to drench

explanation.definitionFit: Exorbitant prices are called this, and the same word means to soak in liquid.

clue.text: Disorganised rustic binder

definitions.meaning: wire used on farms for tying bales of hay

explanation.surface: A muddled farmhand tying up bales.
explanation.definitionFit: Farm wire for baling tangles easily, so the word came to mean gone wrong or out of control.

clue.text: Cast in a devilish mould

indicators.note: to mould is to shape afresh, so these letters are reshaped into the answer

explanation.surface: Something cast in a fiendish mould.
explanation.definitionFit: Belonging to Satan means diabolical or fiendish.

clue.text: Organised travel to ancient city, one's taking a large number

parts.note: taken as written
Ur is the ancient Sumerian city
one is I, and the 's is is
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: A package trip to an old city, with each of the party taking many souvenirs.
explanation.definitionFit: The business of holidays and sightseeing trips is the travel industry.

clue.text: Experience less energy

parts.note: under means less than
go means energy or vigour

explanation.surface: Feeling a drop in vitality.
explanation.definitionFit: To go through something, such as an operation, is to experience it.

clue.text: Mother is French and almost gets rid of music masters

parts.note: ma is a familiar name for mother
est is the French for is

indicators.note: almost means the word stops one letter short of its end

parts.note: rid means free of something

explanation.surface: A French mother nearly abandons her music teachers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' cuts the last letter from RID to give RI.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian plural of a word for a great conductor or composer, a master of music.

clue.text: Musical effect that's a lot more complicated

indicators.note: complicated means tangled, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A musical effect that is much harder to play.
explanation.definitionFit: A wavering, trembling sound in singing or playing is a musical effect.

clue.text: Hit rump in wild jubilation

indicators.note: wild means out of control, so these letters run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone smacks a backside in a fit of glee.
explanation.definitionFit: Exultation over a victory is the feeling of great success.

clue.text: What a worker might assume is the highest

definitions.meaning: a protective garment a workman puts on
taking everything into account, as in the top-placed winner

explanation.surface: A workman donning what is supreme.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a protective work garment one puts on and an adjective for the top-ranked, as an outright winner.

clue.text: Flag stone?

definitions.meaning: to tire or weary, as one flags

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to exhaust or wear out and a green ornamental gemstone.

clue.text: News agencies

parts.note: the press, broadcasting and other means of reporting events

explanation.definitionFit: The press and broadcasters collectively are the outlets that report news.

clue.text: Jewish priest in live broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered, so these letters are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: A rabbi appears on a live transmission.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' rearranges LIVE into the answer; the tribe of Levi supplied Israel's priests.
explanation.definitionFit: Levites, descendants of Jacob's son, served as priests and temple attendants in ancient Israel.

clue.text: Ski badly round point and slowly fall

indicators.note: round means the jumbled letters go around the next piece
badly means done wrong, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: N is the compass point north

explanation.surface: A clumsy skier circles a marker and gradually tumbles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' turns SKI into SIK; 'round' puts it around N.
explanation.definitionFit: To go down gradually, as a ship below the waves, is to descend slowly.

clue.text: Identified unusual sound

indicators.note: sound means the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: something new is novel or unusual

explanation.surface: Someone recognised a strange noise.
explanation.definitionFit: To have recognised someone is to have been aware of who they were.

clue.text: Teams in the market for more than a left-winger

indicators.note: in means the teams go inside the market

parts.note: a mart is a market
an XI is a team of eleven, as in cricket or football

explanation.surface: Football teams looking to buy a winger who plays on the left.
explanation.walkthrough: XI is a team of eleven players; 'for more than a' just confirms the plural.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower of Karl Marx is a socialist on the political left.

clue.text: Tom and Anna upset, in a state

indicators.note: upset means overturned, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Tom and Anna are distressed and in a state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' rearranges TOM and ANNA; 'in a state' sounds like distress but names a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the fifty US states, in the north-west by the Canadian border.

clue.text: Toil assiduously as a probate clerk will do

definitions.text: as a probate clerk will do
definitions.meaning: a clerk handling estates deals with testaments

explanation.surface: Hard work is what someone handling estates after death must do.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to labour with energy, and literally a probate clerk handles a testament.
